intro: The ten most-played Roblox games this week. Blox Fruits passes Adopt Me!, Dandy's World jumps three places after its 1.0 launch, and the relaunched Anime Crusaders X is new at No. 10.
method: Ranked by player counts on the public tracker Endgametools (snapshot Nov 24, 2026, 00:46 UTC), cross-checked with Livecounts (latest update 13:13 UTC, read Nov 24). The trackers disagree in places: Livecounts had Throw Food For Animals at No. 4, 99 Nights in the Forest at No. 6 and Dandy's World at No. 10.

entries.name: Steal An Egg
entries.note: Still No. 1 by a mile, with about 517,000 players on Nov 24.

entries.name: Blox Fruits
entries.note: Up one, with about 248,000 players on Nov 24.

entries.name: Adopt Me!
entries.note: Down one, but close behind with about 242,000 players.

entries.name: Throw Food For Animals
entries.note: Holding No. 5 with about 158,000 players; Livecounts has it at No. 4.

entries.name: Murder Mystery 2
entries.note: Steady at No. 6 with about 147,000 players.

entries.name: Dandy's World [1.0]
entries.note: Up three after leaving alpha, with about 139,000 players on Nov 24.

entries.name: Anime Crusaders X
entries.note: New: relaunched in mid-November, now about 94,000 players.
